evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting monotonically upward during growth: 2.938 → 3.208 Torr while Ar flow steady at ~100 sccm
Flow stable at setpoint 100 sccm, so rise is not a flow change
Temperature holding at 750 °C with stable heater power ~45%
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (not installed) or a flow-off pressure-rise/leak-up test to distinguish a seal leak from partial exhaust blockage; also post-run characterization of the sample.
